buildType.description: The configuration of the build (CMakeLists.txt: Debug, Release, Retail)

debug.long: Not optimized, with the debug tools (F1 panel, profiler, debug pass); libraries *d

release.long: Optimized, with the debug tools (F1 panel, profiler, debug pass); libraries *r

retail.long: Optimized, no debug tools, only warnings and errors in the log; libraries without a suffix
